install.note: The service canonical root is the primary discovery source. Third-party registries may mirror this metadata, but are not required.

securityBoundary.note: ANSS declares safety metadata and adapter entrypoints. The product service remains responsible for authentication, authorization, confirmation, and audit behavior.

authorization.note: Adapter discovery is public, but installation and authenticated calls must follow user or organization policy.

packageDistribution.note: This starter exposes skill-facing guides, not a packaged client-specific Skill bundle.
